title: Problem Solving as Search
overview: Formulate tasks as search problems with states, actions, transition models, goal tests, and path costs.
objectives: Represent a state space as a graph or tree
Evaluate algorithms by completeness, optimality, time, and space

method.title: Formulation
method.body: A search problem has an initial state, available actions, a transition model, a goal test, and a step cost.

method.title: State space
method.body: States are nodes and actions are edges; the search tree unrolls this graph from the initial state.

method.title: Frontier and explored set
method.body: The frontier holds nodes awaiting expansion and an explored set avoids revisiting states.

method.title: Evaluation criteria
method.body: Algorithms are judged by completeness, optimality, and time and space complexity.

pseudocode:
frontier = [initial_state]
explored = set()
while frontier:
    node = frontier.pop(by_strategy)
    if goal_test(node): return path(node)
    explored.add(node)
    frontier += expand(node)
